selection_evidence.signal: The screened contextual workload directed source inspection to the #269 staircase-minor mechanism rather than its high-scoring wrapper.
selection_evidence.mathematical_reading: The #269 uniform approximation proof needs metric separation and finite-dimensional compactness, not merely nonzero minors. The existing ordinary totient approximation note supplies a distinct arithmetic route to separation.
selection_evidence.boundary: The totient consequence was already recorded as ordinary mathematics before this formalization. It is not a new conjecture generated by the score, a held-out discovery, or evidence of causal search advantage.

targets: A bounded family of pairwise separated columns forces a lower bound on uniform approximation by every finite-separated-rank matrix, without bounded-factor assumptions.
The normalized totient Hankel matrix has uniform finite-separated-rank distance exactly one half.
Explicit truncated Mobius divisor sums give finite separated rank and mean absolute error at most 2/D on every leading N by N square.

validation.positive: Compile the exact general statement and arithmetic consumers with the pinned Lean toolchain; inspect axioms and proof dependencies.
validation.negative: Test dropped separation/boundedness hypotheses and the mismatch between the #269-specific interface and the #249 target.
validation.replay: Use the existing premise_exchange runner and proof_state_compiler, with explicit candidates and returned obligations. Do not infer proof-search impossibility from one rejected application.
validation.admission: Promote only statements covered by successful source-current Lean receipts. Keep unfinished arithmetic bridges explicit.

evaluation_boundary: A successful transfer establishes the displayed mathematical statements and replayed applications. It does not establish historical novelty, discovery efficiency, the quality of a learned value model, or an Erdős-problem endpoint.

formalization_sources.role: Generic finite-dimensional obstruction, with counterexamples to dropping boundedness or separation.
Unconditional arithmetic separation arbitrarily far along every pair of distinct rows.
Sharp uniform distance one half, attained by the rank-one midpoint.
All-size mean-error bound with explicit triangular separated-factor budget.
